name: tell-vscode
description: Marks the lines of a Midnight Compact contract that give private data away, in bits, with the fix.
author: Rohan Borade

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Tell runs the Compact compiler on the workspace's contracts.

tell.scanOnSave.description: Scan a contract each time it is saved.

tell.scanOnOpen.description: Scan a contract when it is opened.

tell.minSeverity.description: Show findings at this severity or worse. Info findings are values published on purpose.

tell.compilerVersion.markdownDescription: Compact compiler version to use, for example `0.31.1`. Empty: the version the contract's pragma accepts, preferring 0.31.1.

tell.compilerDirs.markdownDescription: Directories holding `compactc.bin` (or paths to `compactc.bin`). Empty: every version installed by `compact update` under `~/.compact/versions`.

tell.cliPath.markdownDescription: Path to a Tell CLI to run instead of the engine bundled with the extension: a clone's `engine/src/cli.ts` (run with tsx) or a `tell` executable. It is called with `--json`.
